error_transitions.reason: Few discordant source groups; subgroup-only positive multipliers cannot create unobserved transitions and did not preserve the original stratified design. Previous subgroup intervals remain withdrawn.
error_transitions.missing_ci: NA means not estimated; neither zero uncertainty nor no association
error_transitions.sign: new errors minus corrected errors; negative favours Equal VAT

fidelity.primary: Conservative finite-population stratified hypergeometric/Bonferroni bounds, conditional on the reproduced SRSWOR design and fixed adjudicated ratings. Source-dependent outcomes may be arbitrary fixed patterns; no iid outcome model is assumed.
fidelity.secondary: Shared-source exponential multipliers calibrated within cells; exploratory source-dependence sensitivity only.
fidelity.limitation: Finite-population bounds do not estimate transfer to new source groups. Secondary multiplier intervals remain model-assisted; singleton variance is not thereby identified. Neither analysis identifies a causal mechanism.
